cues: A small mouthpiece can be tucked into a jacket pocket while the instrument waits safely in its case.
Its forward-facing bell sends bright notes over a marching crowd during a neighborhood parade.
A short tuning slide can be adjusted before rehearsal to bring the pitch into agreement.
Gold lacquer catches stage lights, while polished silver gives the outer tubing a cooler sheen.
A compact body fits easily beneath an armrest at a school assembly, even when players remain seated.
A small finger ring near the controls helps some young players steady the instrument between notes.
